If a customer stopped EasyPay texts, they can text START to 619-327-9835 to start getting them again.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Help Your Customers Get Our Texts Again
 
 
 
 Hello, 
 Text messaging runs through a long chain of carriers, apps, and filtering systems, and more of them are applying automated opt-outs on a customer’s behalf without notifying the sender.
 If a customer ever replied STOP, blocked our number, or was opted out automatically, they stop getting EasyPay texts – including the application link you send at the counter. Getting them reconnected takes one quick text.
 
 
 
 To Reconnect, Just Text
 START
 to
 619-327-9835
 One text and they’re reconnected right away – no forms, no calls, no waiting.

How to Claim Amazon Rewards - Training
 



 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Amazon Rewards Training

 Hi Lee Myles - Reading,
 
 Follow these quick steps to redeem Amazon rewards in the new EasyPay Business Center. Each funded application earns points that can be converted to Amazon gift cards!

Called and spoke with Miguel to discuss their recent application activity. He shared that most customers are choosing to apply with **EasyPay first**, even though the shop does not actively promote one financing provider over another.

Miguel confirmed they also offer **Snap Finance** and **Synchrony**, although very few customers move forward with Synchrony. He mentioned that when customers are declined by EasyPay, many of them are ultimately approved through Snap Finance.

He also noted that Snap Finance has recently started offering different financing plans to different merchants, which seems to provide additional flexibility for their customers. He was unable to provide many details on how those plans work.

When discussing shop potential, Miguel explained that business has been inconsistent and fluctuating, so he was unable to provide updated metrics at this time.

I sent over my direct contact information and encouraged him to reach out if any questions or concerns aris...

Full Comments:
Called and spoke with Robert. Our conversation focused primarily on the recent application declines he has been experiencing. He shared that **EasyPay is the only financing option** they offer, so when customers are declined, they often have no alternative way to finance their repairs.

Robert provided two recent examples that have been frustrating for both him and his customers. One customer had previously completed a lease with EasyPay but was declined when applying again. Another customer was initially approved, but after the approval expired and they reapplied, the second application was denied.

Robert expressed frustration with these situations because EasyPay is their only financing solution for customers who cannot pay the full repair cost upfront. I acknowledged his concerns, thanked him for the feedback, and encouraged him to continue reaching out whenever he encounters situations where we may be able to assist.

Subject: 00TTO000010c7ET2AY
Full Comments:
Called and identified Jeff as the manager for the location. Brian is listed as the owner. I was able to gather additional shop potential information, including a **lower average repair order of approximately $450**.

Jeff shared that they currently work with **Snap Finance and Koalafi**. When discussing where EasyPay fits into their financing options, he explained that it depends on the customer, as they typically present multiple options and allow the customer to choose which provider they would like to move forward with.

I recommended that they consider running EasyPay first, as the program tends to perform best when it is presented before receiving declines from other financing providers. Jeff appreciated the feedback and thanked me for the suggestion.

I sent over my contact information and encouraged him to reach out if any questions or concerns come up.

If a customer stopped EasyPay texts, they can text START to 619-327-9835 to start getting them again.

 Hello, 
 Text messaging runs through a long chain of carriers, apps, and filtering systems, and more of them are applying automated opt-outs on a customer’s behalf without notifying the sender.
 If a customer ever replied STOP, blocked our number, or was opted out automatically, they stop getting EasyPay texts – including the application link you send at the counter. Getting them reconnected takes one quick text.
 
 
 
 To Reconnect, Just Text
 START
 to

 One text and they’re reconnected right away – no forms, no calls, no waiting.
 
 
 
 How you can help:

Full Comments:
Completed LTO training with David. During the training, I clearly communicated that we are not allowed to ship accessories, merchandise, or any other products. I also explained that the lease-to-own program is only available to Florida residents and that a valid government-issued ID must be verified in person.

I further advised David that this is a lease agreement and is therefore tax-exempt. As a result, no taxes should be added to the invoice.

David advised that they work with Verizon as a third-party provider. He also mentioned that they offer in-house credit and an additional loan option; however, he did not specify the lenders associated with those financing programs.

Full Comments: Spoke with merchant and assisted with logging into the new Business Center portal. Confirmed Brian as the primary point of contact and will use the secondary phone number for future outreach. Brian shared that there is little perceived demand for financing, despite average repair orders starting around $500 and reaching up to $9,000. Based on the discussion, there is clear opportunity for financing, but the location lacks a strong credit culture, with customers overwhelmingly choosing to pay via cash, debit, or personal credit cards. Offered sales/finance training, but Brian declined, stating the team is already comfortable with the platform and navigation. Marketing materials were also declined, as they have sufficient inventory. Merchant also offers Snap Finance, but Brian indicated it sees similar usage, as customers are generally not requesting financing regardless of provider. Opportunity remains to build financing awareness and strengthen credit culture over time.

All sales must be completed in person.
ID verification must be conducted in person for every transaction.
Leasing is available only to residents of the State of Florida.
No shipping is permitted under any circumstances.
Taxes must not be added to the lease.
Florida Reseller's Tax Form will be provided via email.

Sophie confirmed that she understands all of the requirements and procedures. She stated that she will follow these guidelines to ensure compliance and help establish a strong and successful partnership.

Called and spoke with Joanna to follow up on their most recent funded application. She mentioned that the overall process was straightforward and easy, but she was initially confused about the sales tax. She had expected the taxes to be included in the funded amount.

I clarified that EasyPay collects sales tax directly from the customer, so the merchant does not need to collect it, and explained that I would be sending over the resale certificate, which serves as documentation allowing them to avoid paying sales tax on that specific transaction. She understood the explanation and appreciated the clarification.

I also informed her that they have been added to the $10 Amazon gift card incentive program for each funded application. Since EasyPay is currently the only financing option they are using, I encouraged them to continue promoting it, especially with the increase in A/C repair jobs they have been seeing recently. Full Comments:
CRM Notes:

Spoke with Ruben regarding current business conditions. He shared that business is at an all-time low, comparing the current environment to the 2008 financial crisis. He attributes much of the slowdown to an oversaturated San Diego auto glass market and increased competition from independent mobile installers with minimal overhead and operating costs. Ruben stated that while their business does offer mobile service, it is an additional paid service and they have no plans to transition to a fully mobile model.

Ruben and his cousins own four auto glass locations, all of which are experiencing similar declines in business. He noted that even their glass suppliers and vendors are reporting historically slow demand, reinforcing that the slowdown appears to be industry-wide. He believes auto glass is often viewed as a discretionary purchase, causing customers to delay repairs or aggressively shop for the lowest price.

We scheduled an EasyPay training/demo for Monday at 12:00 PM. I will also be sending him my contact information for future support. Frisco was referred to EasyPay by another merchant account that has had great success with our program, and he is excited to begin working with us.

Overall, Ricardo is very happy with the program. He has one additional application expected to fund before the end of the month, so I enrolled the account in a $10 Amazon gift card promotion to encourage continued EasyPay usage. I also walked him through creating a Rewards user so he can redeem future gift cards without any issue...
